picks.title: Mistral raises €3B
picks.why_it_matters: A €3B raise for an open-weight AI company signals continued massive capital flows into foundational AI infrastructure and validates the European AI ecosystem as a serious competitor to US players.

picks.title: Leaving VMware just got harder after Broadcom pulled VDDK downloads
picks.why_it_matters: Broadcom's aggressive VMware lock-in creates a window for startups building migration tools, alternative virtualization platforms, or cloud-native infrastructure to capture enterprise customers seeking exits.

picks.title: TALA Is Open-Source
picks.why_it_matters: Open-sourcing TALA (automatic layout engine for D2) strengthens the developer tooling ecosystem and may accelerate adoption of diagram-as-code workflows—worth watching for adjacent opportunities in technical documentation and AI-assisted diagramming.
